copy.note: Manual transcription of all three actual word-lines; only allowed word breaks differ from one-line source.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 검은 글자와 흰 단색 배경만 사용한다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Black letters and white-looking background only, but a faint allover grain is visible at original detail, with faint soft gray fringes under a few strokes.

mandatory_conditions.observed: 숨과 / 숨 / 사이 once; both required 숨 present, no third.
No pictorial elements or extra characters; subtle generated surface grain remains.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 어절을 보존하고 어절 사이 줄바꿈만 허용한다. 글자 내부 구조를 장식 그림으로 해체하지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Three whole words, all Hangul structures intact.

located_observations.location: upper 숨과, center 숨, lower 사이
located_observations.observed: All syllables are correctly formed and naturally proportioned; middle 숨 is larger, line left edges are optically aligned and counters remain open.

located_observations.location: two white intervals between three word-lines
located_observations.observed: Large clean intervals produce the vertical breathing sequence; middle word anchors it. At 320-longside all three words remain recognizable.

located_observations.location: blank right side, top white margin, black glyph interiors
located_observations.observed: Faint allover background grain and slight black mottling; no intentional material needed here. This weakens the explicit flat-white requirement.

located_observations.location: beneath center 숨 horizontal/base edges and lower 사이 stems
located_observations.observed: Faint soft fringes look like an unwanted generated print/shadow effect. No fake microcopy, ornaments, duplicated words or deformed Hangul seen.

uncertainties: The extent of near-white pixel variation is not treated as print material certification; visual surface grain is enough to target a correction.
decision: repair-1 to flatten background and letter surfaces while preserving the typography and space.
